# 🧬 Pokefun SMP — Ultimate Cobblemon Multiplayer Server

**The most advanced Cobblemon multiplayer experience ever created.**

Built on **Cobblemon 1.7.3 + Fabric 1.21.1**, Pokefun transforms Minecraft into a **fully playable Pokémon world** with competitive battles, raids, exploration, and a powerful multiplayer economy.

Whether you're a **casual trainer, competitive battler, or content creator**, Pokefun delivers a complete Pokémon MMO-style experience inside Minecraft.

---

# 🌍 A True Pokémon World Inside Minecraft

Explore a massive survival world where Pokémon spawn naturally and adventures never end.

✨ **ALL Pokémon Available**
✨ **Legendaries, Mythicals & Ultra Beasts spawn naturally**
✨ **Custom Legendary Summoning Structures**
✨ **Wild Pokémon Battles**
✨ **Capture XP System**
✨ **1200+ PC Storage (Living Dex Ready)**
✨ **Daily Tasks & Progression System**

This isn't just survival — it's a **living Pokémon world.**

---

# ⚔️ Advanced Pokémon Battle Systems

Pokefun includes battle mechanics normally found only in competitive Pokémon games.

✔ Mega Evolution
✔ Dynamax & Gigantamax
✔ Z-Moves
✔ Terastallization
✔ Alpha Pokémon
✔ Primal Forms
✔ Custom Battle Points System
✔ Competitive Trainer Level Caps

⚔ **Raid Dens & Raid Gyms**
⚔ **Custom Boss Pokémon Events**
⚔ **NPC Trainer Battles**

Battle like a true Pokémon champion.

Explore structures filled with **rare loot, bosses, and secrets.**

⚡ Lag-free multiplayer experience
